Context: 6. Permanent transfer to and from Central Autonomous/Statutory Bodies Counting of past service for pension

by the Autonomous Body to the concerned Government Department. The option should be exercised within one year from the date of absorption, failing which he will be deemed to have opted to receive CPF benefits.
